hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/backend/"*.py) b="${f%%/backend/*}/backend"; cd "$b" || exit 0; env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv run ruff format -q "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/backend" || exit 0; out=$(env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv run basedpyright 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }
